entries.title: Gupshup raises $60M in equity and debt, leaves unicorn status hanging
entries.summary: Gupshup has raised over $60 million in a new round over four years after attaining the unicorn status.
entries.author: Jagmeet Singh

entries.title: Amazon acquires Bee, the AI wearable that records everything you say
entries.summary: Amazon has acquired the AI wearables startup Bee, which makes a bracelet and an Apple Watch app that record your day-to-day life to function as an AI assistant.
entries.author: Amanda Silberling

entries.title: OpenAI agreed to pay Oracle $30B a year for data center services
entries.summary: OpenAI was the customer that signed the huge deal that Oracle disclosed last month.
entries.author: Julie Bort

entries.title: iOS 26 beta 4 arrives, with Liquid Glass tweaks and AI news summaries
entries.summary: Apple launches iOS 26 beta 4 for developers with updates to Liquid Glass and AI notification summaries. A public beta is expected later this week.
entries.author: Sarah Perez

entries.title: UK government wants ransomware victims to report breaches so it can carry out ‘targeted disruptions’ against hackers
entries.summary: Experts applauded the proposed change, which would require ransomware victims to notify authorities when paying a hacker's ransom, arguing that this information can help catch cybercriminals and stop their activities.
entries.author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai

entries.title: National security meets next-gen tech at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025’s AI Defense panel
entries.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 runs October 27-29 at Moscone West in San Francisco. Join 10,000+ startup and VC leaders for three days of conversations and connections that define what’s next.
entries.author: TechCrunch Events

entries.title: User privacy app Cloaked adds AI-powered caller screening
entries.summary: Cloaked is releasing a new call guard feature to let an AI-powered bot chat to scammers on a user's behalf.
entries.author: Ivan Mehta

entries.title: Onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025: How AI is forcing late-stage startups to rewire GTM — or be left behind
entries.summary: AI isn’t just disrupting products — it’s upending how companies sell, scale, and succeed. At TechCrunch Disrupt 2025, happening October 27-29 in San Francisco, we’re diving deep into how late-stage startups are navigating this shift.
entries.author: TechCrunch Events

entries.title: VSCO’s iPhone camera app is now available globally
entries.summary: Photo editing and sharing app VSCO is making its iOS camera app, Capture, available across the world, following a limited launch in June, when the app came to Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.
entries.author: Ivan Mehta

entries.title: 21-year-old MIT dropouts raise $32M at $300M valuation led by Insight
entries.summary: Karun Kaushik and Selin Kocalar weren’t planning to raise a Series A so soon for their startup Delve. But inbound interest started rolling in, and the startup recently closed a $32 million Series A at a $300 million valuation.
entries.author: Tage Kene-Okafor

entries.title: Betaworks’ third fund closes at $66M to invest in early-stage AI startups
entries.summary: Betaworks has been investing in AI since at least 2016. Fund III will seek to invest in at least 25 pre-seed to seed investments, as well as make at least 50 investments into startups.
entries.author: Dominic-Madori Davis

entries.title: Nevoya raises $9.3M as its EV truck fleet reaches cost parity with diesel
entries.summary: All-electric truck fleet startup Nevoya has landed a fresh round of capital and plans to expand.
entries.author: Sean O'Kane

entries.title: Lucid Air owners will soon be able to use Tesla Superchargers — but there’s a catch
entries.summary: Owners of the Lucid Air sedan will be able to charge their luxury EVs at thousands of Tesla Supercharger stations in North America starting July 31. But there is a notable caveat: Lucid Air vehicles won't be able to charge as fast as Tesla vehicles.
entries.author: Kirsten Korosec
